(KX Kη : Set ℝ) (hKX : IsCompact KX) (hKη : IsCompact Kη) (k : ℕ) : ∃ CE CU : ℝ, 0 ≤ CE ∧ 0 ≤ CU ∧ ∀ n : ℝ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ X ∈ KX, ∀ η ∈ Kη, |iteratedDeriv k (realizedE r E n X) η - iteratedDeriv k (fun e => E (X, e)) η| ≤ CE / n ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (realizedU r E U n X) η - iteratedDeriv k (fun e => U (X, e)) η| ≤ CU / n
